items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: She came down there to study... Her name was Billie Love I'll never forget. I used to go sit and talk with her at night.

ctx.x: So he let us all off and the T. found a band and we all went to hear Louie and that was really the first time I really heard him in person. He had a big band, about -- I think he had about 12, 13 piece band then. But he was really sharp that night and there used to be a little girl that lived just across the room from me in the hotel. She came down there to study. She was having a problem at home, very nice girl, very beautiful girl. Everybody had eyes, but nobody could really make her, you know, they never…

I used to go sit and talk with her at night. She says, 'Buddy,' she says, 'you know, the reason I'm away from home, I can't study at home. My mother and dad --' they were having some kind of little problems and it was interfering with her thinking, you know. And she says, 'But if I would go with anybody, it would maybe be you, but I'm not going to do it.'
